name: Duchies of Vinci
genericName: DaVinci Humans||Duchies of Vinci||Duchies of Vinci
background:
The Duchies of Vinci are an army of highly advanced Humans assisted by their robotic automatons. On the battlefield, they rely on ranged warfare using crossbows and cannons, supported by the more resilient Automa. 

They were once a collection of poor villages who discovered the intelligence-enhancing Mindstones in the aftermath of the Rift. The Vinci have gained great wealth and knowledge, but guard their secrets and their Mindstones closely to protect themselves from poverty. However, over time, their isolationism has fostered rivalry between the Duchies, causing them to stagnate.
backgroundFull:
The Vinci were once amongst the poorest people in Tyria, a meagre collection of villages built on swampland. Without any source of wealth, they were subsistence farmers who were largely disregarded by the wider Empire and other outsiders as mere peasants. 

When the Great Rift opened, the Vinci’s homelands were devastated by violent earthquakes. Soon after these quakes, however, glowing stones began to emerge from the depths of the swamps. At first, the stones were simply used to create jewellery, but soon the stones started to affect people’s minds and made them smarter, leading to a new time of technological and cultural progress. They became known as Mindstones soon after, and it was not long before the Vinci had taken every stone that they could find until almost none remained undiscovered. 

Influenced by their Mindstones, the Vinci started building machines to drain the swamps and reclaim the land. They expanded their farmland, built great cities, and became very rich, very quickly. The Vinci established universities that attracted the best minds in all the land, which led to the invention of robots known as Automa. These robots assisted the Vinci with farming, construction, and generally served to boost the advancement of the Vinci even more. 

As the Vinci began to prosper, they found themselves surrounded by enemies. Outsiders sought to claim these newfound riches for themselves and began to stake claims upon the Vinci and their Mindstones. When conflict broke out, the Vinci armies turned the tides and soon conquered their neighbours.

In order to defend themselves from future conflicts, the Vinci turned their cities into fortresses and expelled all foreign diplomats and scholars. The isolated Duchies became even more reliant on advanced technology to make up for their losses in trade. Now, Universities are the real power in Vinci, while Dukes have become mere figureheads. This led to them being highly insular and suspicious, with their universities waging secret wars of sabotage and espionage on each other. 

How will you ensure the prosperity of your duchy?

product.description: An experienced Vinci Captain, rarely seen without her beloved Automa Eagle, Carmia. Lucrezza retired from military service after losing her leg and the rest of her company in an ambush. Ignatio’s offer of employment has given this captain a chance at proving herself once more and redeeming her reputation. Her experiences have made her a more cautious commander, determined to protect those under her leadership.

Hailing from the western Duchy of Noverra, Zairetia grew up as an Inventor’s apprentice. Her tutor noticed her curiosity and intelligence, encouraging her to continue her studies. But even after the University of Noverra granted her the title of Inventor, she felt unfulfilled. Eager to push the boundaries of science even further, she decided to learn Alchemy.

A promising young inventor from a prestigious family, Ignatio is an expert with automa but struggles with people. From an early age, Ignatio has always been determined to step out from his wealthy family’s shadow. He believes that he will finally be able to do so with the aid of his most recent invention, a device that detects the intelligence enhancing mindstone which powers Vinci automa. He has obtained funding and loans in hopes of discovering new Mindstone deep in Saurian territory, near the ancient city of Tixal.

Mantissa grew up in a small village in the border Duchy of Ortezza. Like many peasants of the Paretemi mountains, she learned to shoot a crossbow before she could walk. She made a name for herself as a child by winning several shooting contests. But when she was a teenager, most of Mantissa’s family was slain during a Daemon raid. She swore to avenge their deaths and became a mercenary, seeking employment with any Captain who was fighting Daemons.

product.description: Mambrecco is considered to be one of the “Old Dukes”, whose families were in power long before the technological revolution caused by the discovery of Mindstone. As such, he is a staunch traditionalist, known for despising scholars and merchants and priding himself on martial prowess only. A grizzled warrior, he has put his life on the line many times in defense of his title. His daughter Lucrezza is a capable commander in her own right, as he has trained her to be.

Gerepetto Collodi once had a bright future. He was one of the rising stars of the University of Ollenna, a brilliant young Inventor with groundbreaking ideas for improving Automa design and autonomy. He spent every waking hour developing prototypes, working faster than any of his peers.

But over the years, Gerepetto changed. He would talk to the stars and declare that his next Automa would be a “real boy”. Despite his genius, people around him were worried that he had been driven insane by constant exposure to high quantities of Mindstone.

product.description: The Duchies of Vinci are renowned across Tyria for their technological prowess, so it comes as no surprise that Inventors have such a prestigious image. Experts in their field, these men and women accompany their army in campaign, maintaining and improving its Automa and weapons.

Among the ranks of the Duchies of Vinci, Alchemists hold a peculiar place. Unlike Inventors and Engineers with their mechanized creations, the Alchemists’ area of expertise lies in the occult and the arcane. Using their knowledge of the arcane to create potent potions, oils, and incense, which they may put to use either by healing the sick and wounded or sowing death and mayhem among the ranks of their enemies.

Captains are the leaders of the Vinci companies, the most elite commanders to be found within the Duchies. Veterans of many battles, they use their experience to direct their troops in the most efficient manner possible, often sending orders and receiving reports with the help of an Automa Pigeon.

Master Assassins are the leaders of their Guild. Their exact number is kept secret, but there are few of them, as rising through the ranks of the Assassins’ Guild involves many close calls and hidden blades. They tend to wear a mask and travel secretly, so much so that sometimes the Vinci soldiers themselves don’t know they have this ace up their sleeves until the very last minute.

Beautifully decorated in the colours of its Duchy or company, the Army Standard serves as a rallying point for Vinci soldiers. The accompanying sergeant can dispatch field orders and deliver rousing speeches or blustering insults to strengthen his comrades’ resolve, while the musician plays military hymns to set marching speed, announce charges, and draw the ranks.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Vinci Tech
specialRules.description: If this model has Versatile Attack, it always gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls from Versatile Attack (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Quick Throw
specialRules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Vinci Tech
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when this unit attacks enemies for the first time each round, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: This hero may only be taken once per party.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Piercing Spotter
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Precision Spotter
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. Friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed tokens.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: This model's melee weapons get AP(+2) against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Crossing Strike
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Protected
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Unstoppable in melee.

specialRules.name: Puncture
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Versatile Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Versatile Attack, it always gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls from Versatile Attack (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Versatile Warrior
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when this unit attacks enemies for the first time each round, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: May target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores cover from sight obstructions, but gets -1 to hit rolls when shooting after moving.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
